owner_intent: Stop writing and publishing new articles on /global. Continue comprehensive independent SEO for all 10 languages using published pages, existing site code and the established A-Z SEO Matrix. Make progress without interruption or approval questions.
supersedes_for_operations: Topic Factory intake/production as a priority during SEO-only mode
Proactive activation of new Hubs/Supporting pages
allowed: Audit and improve existing published URLs without creating new URLs
Optimize commercial keywords independently in ten locales with unique search intent
Improve existing Pillar/Hub/Supporting content, titles, descriptions, heading structure, internal links, breadcrumbs, structured data, topical images and alt
Repair canonical, sitemap, robots, proper hreflang equivalences, Core Web Vitals, accessibility and indexing issues supported by evidence
Use existing SEO A-Z matrices and workbooks; update accurate ledgers after verified implementation
Fix errors, run full CI, deploy and live-verify changes, merge passed PRs through authorized procedure
forbidden: Write or publish new articles or new URLs, including from queued Writer drafts
Promote new topics merely to reach article counts
Create new language pages or empty Hubs; PR #118 requires a later, separate owner directive before merge
Bypass PR protection, QA or Live QA; force push
Invent metrics, rankings, reviews, source evidence, facts, business NAP, prices or editorial human review
Change data/business/reference.json or business LocalBusiness fields without verified approval
Ask owner to install, connect or explain GA4/GSC/Google Analytics in the middle of SEO work
Request API keys, paid upgrades or unneeded administrative access
policy_on_missing_data: Keep implementing all independent SEO tasks. Record missing GSC/GA4 data, verifications and external-account actions in a final OWNER_ACTIONS section at the end of work. No intermittent questions, admin setup tutorials, or blocking for optional analytics. Do not claim rankings without measurement.
reporting: Only after finishing the executable SEO work, write an evidence-based final summary of completed work and unresolved blockers, with exact URLs, PRs, CI and live-verify status. Keep a running internal ledger instead of asking questions.
resume: Whenever owner says 'tiếp tục', re-read this directive, AGENTS.md and SEO execution ledger, inspect current main, resume next unfinished SEO-only task. No new article production.
publication_pause: Any existing Auto Publisher queue should be paused to enforce no new URLs. Existing published content remains live and fully editable for SEO.
completion_definition: All executable SEO improvements on published pages audited, implemented, PR-merged, deployed and verified; remaining external-account/measurement/owner-identification tasks listed last; ranking 1-3 is aspirational and not claimed as achieved.
